```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo    = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.width  = 11,
  fig.height = 6,
  dpi        = 180,

)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(scales)
  library(knitr)
  library(kableExtra)
})

source("src/report_style.R")
source("src/diagnostics_io.R")
set_report_style()

# Scientific settings are read from the result, never inferred from this run.
disambig_dir <- params$disambig_dir
output_dir <- params$output_dir
stopifnot(!is.null(disambig_dir))
inputs <- load_asr_diagnostics(disambig_dir)
posterior_threshold <- inputs$posterior_threshold
requested_threshold <- params$posterior_threshold
if (!is.null(requested_threshold)) {
  if (length(requested_threshold) != 1) asr_fail("Invalid requested posterior threshold")
  requested_threshold <- asr_number(requested_threshold, "requested posterior threshold", upper = 1)
}
threshold_mismatch <- !is.null(requested_threshold) && !is.na(posterior_threshold) &&
  requested_threshold != posterior_threshold

# ── Output directories ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Tables go to tsv/ and figures to plots/, both published by ASR_DIAGNOSTICS_REPORT.
tsv_dir   <- file.path(output_dir, "tsv")
plots_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "plots")
dir.create(tsv_dir,   recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(plots_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

write_tsv_safe <- function(df, fname) {
  readr::write_tsv(df, file.path(tsv_dir, fname))
  invisible(file.path(tsv_dir, fname))
}

save_plot <- function(p, fname, width = 11, height = 6) {
  ggsave(file.path(plots_dir, fname), plot = p, width = width, height = height, dpi = 180)
  invisible(file.path(plots_dir, fname))
}

.tableau10 <- report_palette(10)
```

## Introduction

`asr_path_score` is the CAAS convergence score of a position on the K fixed Voronoi domains of the contrast design. Positive scores are emitted per phenotype side (`top` and/or `bottom`). If neither side scores positively, the position contributes one diagnostic `side=none` row with score zero. Its classification and agreement describe the side with the most changed domains (ties: greatest agreement numerator, then top). These rows are shown separately, not assigned to a phenotype side.

For one hypothesis and one side, a domain is *changed* when its observed foreground residue differs from the modal ancestral residue at the MRCA of its pair. A changed domain scores the noisy-OR, over the changed domains that carry the same residue, of `1 - P`, where `P` is the posterior mass of that residue at the LCA of the two domains. `P` is the recorded mass of the residue and, when the residue is not in the recorded distribution of the node, the whole unrecorded mass (worst case). A changed domain without a same-residue partner scores 0. Within each domain and side, scores are first averaged over all design hypotheses represented by each species, including zero for hypotheses that did not detect the position. The domain score is the PSS-weighted mean over distinct species (weights are their mean PSS; equal weights if all are zero). The row score is the unweighted mean over all K domains. Domains without evidence contribute zero and remain in the denominator. The score rule is `caas_pos_species_pss_v4`; this aggregation is a score, not a calibrated probability of independent origins.

`derived_agreement` is `agree_num / agree_den`: the fraction of the changed domains whose modal derived residue is the most frequent one. It describes the row and does not enter the score.

The posterior threshold removes from the recorded distribution of a node every residue below it, except the most probable one. Removed mass is unrecorded, so a higher threshold can only raise `P` and lower the scores. The threshold is applied when the ASR posteriors are read; this report shows its value and does not vary it. The value displayed below comes from the observed completion record, including when results from another run are reused.

---

```{r load-data}
master_df <- inputs$data
score_df <- master_df
n_positions <- score_df %>% distinct(gene, msa_pos) %>% nrow()
if (!nrow(score_df)) cat("**No observed positions were detected.** The completed empty result is valid; summary tables retain their headers and plots are omitted.\n")

```

> **Recorded posterior threshold**: **`r if (is.na(posterior_threshold)) "not provided" else posterior_threshold`**
>
> **ASR model**: `r inputs$model`; **score rule**: `caas_pos_species_pss_v4`; **genes excluded by whitelist**: `r inputs$excluded_genes`
>
> **Disambiguation directory**: `r disambig_dir`
>
> **Rows in the master** (gene × position × side): `r format(nrow(master_df), big.mark = ",")`
>
> **Evaluated rows (including diagnostic zeros)**: `r format(nrow(score_df), big.mark = ",")`, over `r format(n_positions, big.mark = ",")` positions in `r n_distinct(score_df$gene)` genes

```{r threshold-note, results='asis'}
if (threshold_mismatch) cat(sprintf("**Configuration differs:** this run requests threshold %s; these results were scored with %s. All diagnostics use the recorded value.\n", requested_threshold, posterior_threshold))
```

```{r rows-table}
score_df %>%
  count(side, name = "Rows") %>%
  kable(format = "html", caption = "Evaluated rows per side (none = diagnostic zero)") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"), full_width = FALSE)
```

## 1. Distribution of the ASR path score

```{r plot-score-dist, fig.height=4, fig.cap="Distribution of asr_path_score per side."}
if (nrow(score_df)) {
p_score <- ggplot(score_df, aes(x = asr_path_score)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.02, fill = .tableau10[1], colour = "white", alpha = 0.85) +
  facet_wrap(~ side, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "ASR path score",
    subtitle = sprintf("%s scored rows, %s positions",
                       formatC(nrow(score_df), big.mark = ","), formatC(n_positions, big.mark = ",")),
    x = "asr_path_score",
    y = "Rows"
  )

print(p_score)
save_plot(p_score, "asr_path_score_distribution.png", width = 9, height = 5)
}
```

---

## 2. Derived agreement

Classification percentages use rows with a recorded classification; ambiguity percentages use rows with a recorded flag. Missing descriptors remain unavailable. `none` rows retain the diagnostic categories `divergent`, `single`, `no_change`, `symplesiomorphic` (agreement within a hypothesis but zero score), or `cross_hypothesis` (agreement only after pooling hypotheses and zero score).

`derived_agreement` is a descriptor of the row (see Introduction). `agreement_ambiguous` marks rows where a changed domain had two derived residues tied across hypotheses and the smallest residue was taken by convention; for those rows, `derived_agreement` and `convergence_type` rest on that convention.

```{r plot-agreement, fig.height=4, fig.cap="Distribution of derived_agreement per side."}
agree_df <- score_df %>% filter(!is.na(derived_agreement))

if (nrow(agree_df)) {
p_agree <- ggplot(agree_df, aes(x = derived_agreement)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.05, fill = .tableau10[3], colour = "white", alpha = 0.85) +
  facet_wrap(~ side, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Derived agreement", x = "derived_agreement", y = "Rows")

print(p_agree)
save_plot(p_agree, "derived_agreement_distribution.png", width = 9, height = 5)
} else cat("Derived agreement is unavailable for these rows; the plot is omitted.\n")
```

```{r agreement-table}
agree_tab <- score_df %>%
  group_by(Side = side) %>%
  summarise(
    Rows = n(),
    `Convergent (%)` = asr_percent(convergence_type == "convergent"),
    `Divergent (%)`  = asr_percent(convergence_type == "divergent"),
    `Single (%)`     = asr_percent(convergence_type == "single"),
    `No change (%)` = asr_percent(convergence_type == "no_change"),
    `Symplesiomorphic (%)` = asr_percent(convergence_type == "symplesiomorphic"),
    `Cross hypothesis (%)` = asr_percent(convergence_type == "cross_hypothesis"),
    `Classified rows` = sum(!is.na(convergence_type)),
    `Agreement flags available` = sum(!is.na(agreement_ambiguous)),
    `Ambiguous agreement (%)` = asr_percent(agreement_ambiguous),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_tsv_safe(agree_tab, "convergence_type_by_side.tsv")

agree_tab %>%
  kable(format = "html", digits = 2, caption = "Convergence type and ambiguous agreement per side (convergence_type_by_side.tsv)") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"), full_width = FALSE)
```

---

## 3. Summary statistics

```{r summary-table}
summary_table <- score_df %>%
  select(side, asr_path_score, derived_agreement) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(asr_path_score, derived_agreement), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "value") %>%
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
  group_by(Variable, Side = side) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(), Mean = if (n()) mean(value) else NA_real_, Median = if (n()) median(value) else NA_real_,
    SD = sd(value), Min = if (n()) min(value) else NA_real_, Max = if (n()) max(value) else NA_real_,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_tsv_safe(summary_table, "asr_path_summary_statistics.tsv")

summary_table %>%
  kable(format = "html", digits = 4, caption = "Summary statistics per side (asr_path_summary_statistics.tsv)") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"), full_width = FALSE)
```
